description: Devau, Nicolas and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented Fortran tool converts water-flux and PFAS-concentration time series at the groundwater interface into inputs for MT3DMS. It supports the described coupled HYDRUS/MODFLOW flow calculation and subsequent saturated-zone solute-transport simulation. Source, executable, documentation and an example are identified by native metadata and the exact public repository. The native description specifies Fortran, while GitHub automatic language metadata reports Fluent; this discrepancy is preserved without examining code. The current repository is MIT, distinct from the deposit CC-BY label. No executable or input body was downloaded. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
